name: @worthlane/desktop-native
description: Secure native macOS and Windows app for the Worthlane desktop workspace

scripts.typecheck: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/navigation.cjs && node --check src/security.cjs && node --check src/offline.js && node --check scripts/write-config.cjs && node --check scripts/verify-origin.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-package.cjs && node --check scripts/after-pack.cjs && node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node --check scripts/check-mac-signing.cjs
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/verify-origin.mjs && node scripts/write-config.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/verify-package.cjs --production
scripts.pack:mac:local: node scripts/write-config.cjs --allow-local && electron-builder --mac --dir --arm64 -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.notarize=false --publish never && node scripts/verify-package.cjs release/mac-arm64/Worthlane.app
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-mac-signing.cjs && node scripts/verify-origin.mjs && node scripts/write-config.cjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true
